renderer: HOA2 -> 11 virtual speakers -> soft-top4 KEMAR binaural
normalization: One common source gain and optional shared peak-safety attenuation per song, across original and all 16 variants. No per-variant loudness/tonal matching.
source_path: Labeled M/S stems; original is the stereo sum of those same stems. No source-separator inference.
selection: Three different MoisesDB genre labels with salient instrument/vocal excerpts from the existing source-based selection. Curated demonstration, not an additional evaluation set.
